Bill.BriefDescription: Increasing legislative transparency by providing mandatory notice and waiting periods before legislative action, banning title-only bills, and opening all legislative committees to the public.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to increasing legislative transparency by providingmandatory notice and waiting periods before legislative action, banningtitle-only bills, and opening all legislative committees to the public;and adding new sections to chapter 44.04 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 44.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) All bills introduced, and any proposed substitute, strikingamendment, or conference committee report thereon, must be madepublicly available to the members of the legislature and the public atleast seventytwo hours before the bill is eligible for a publichearing, legislative action, or to be voted on by the senate or thehouse of representatives. (2) At least seventytwo hours notice must be given of all publichearings held by any legislative committee. Such notice shall containthe date, time, and place of the hearing together with the title andnumber of each bill, or identification of the subject matter, to beconsidered at the hearing. p. 1 HB 2369 (3) No bill is eligible for legislative action of any kind unlessit has first been subject to a public hearing in the same session ofconsideration. (4) No bill is eligible for legislative action on the floor ofeither the senate or house of representatives until fortyeight hoursafter it has been placed on the floor calendar. (5) No bill is eligible for final passage in either house of thelegislature unless copies of the bill, in the final form to be passed,have been made available to the members of that house of thelegislature and the public for at least twentyfour hours. (6) This section may be suspended by a twothirds vote of themembers elected to the house of the legislature in which it is pending,and every individual consideration of a bill or action suspending thissection must be recorded in the journal of the respective house of thelegislature.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 44.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: No bill is eligible for public hearing or legislative considerationof any kind unless the bill lays forth in full the changes to any actor sections of law. Titleonly bills are prohibited.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 44.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) All committees of the legislature are open to the public andshall follow the requirements of chapter 42.30 RCW. (2) A policy committee may not temporarily adjourn solely for thepurpose of allowing caucus meetings with the public excluded so thatcommittee members may discuss a pending vote on a bill or amendmentprior to committee action on a bill.
